Detection lists adapted from https://github.com/LinXiaoTao/FuckClaude/blob/master/src/config/signals.ts on 2026-09-11. MIT license retained. Font lists, timezone names, browser/device patterns are reused. The initial observation-only adapter did not use upstream weights. The integration below now uses the original detectors and weights, labelled as project heuristics rather than Claude account risk assessments.

Upstream signals.ts SHA-256: `5834859752978754facf8dc0a80157f4ade50d091e7a630aa27071bb3854c8fd`.

2026-09-11 integration: `signals.ts` is now an unchanged copy of upstream `src/config/signals.ts` (same SHA-256 above), fetched from master and checked against the previous snapshot. `src/views/claude/score.ts` runs its ten detectors with a four-second timeout and sums original weighted scores. The UI uses upstream hit threshold 0.25 and low/medium/high bands, labelled as project heuristics. Unavailable/failed signals prevent a complete band. No upstream UI, tracking, advertising or CAPTCHA is included. The original WebRTC detector uses Google STUN; Emoji uses upstream UA vendor estimation. Earlier observation-only device modules remain available separately.
